data.title: 22-year-old pleads guilty in $240 million bitcoin heist, one of the largest in US history | CNN
data.description: A 22-year-old man pleaded guilty on Tuesday to teaming up with friends to steal nearly a quarter-billion dollars in bitcoin from a Washington, DC, resident — one of the largest cryptocurrency thefts in US history — and then embarking on a wild spending spree with the laundered proceeds.
